dz: 克隆塔夫战役:爱尔兰高王布赖恩·博鲁击败了维京侵略者,但战死.
de: Battle of Clontarf: High King of Ireland Brian Boru defeats Viking invaders, but is killed in battle.

dz: 拜占庭-保加利亚战争：克莱迪翁战役：拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世对保加利亚军队造成了决定性的失败，据报道，他随后对 15,000 名囚犯的治疗导致保加利亚沙皇萨缪尔在不到三个月后的 10 月 6 日死于心脏病。
de: Byzantine–Bulgarian wars: Battle of Kleidion: Byzantine emperor Basil II inflicts a decisive defeat on the Bulgarian army, and his subsequent treatment of 15,000 prisoners reportedly causes Tsar Samuil of Bulgaria to die of a heart attack less than three months later, on October 6.
